# What the net fixes of one's own class

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-the-net-fixes-of-ones-own-class` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](what-the-net-fixes-of-ones-own-class.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where a class meets the path's regularity and holds one's effects, the net fixes the least such class, oneself with everything downstream, and every such class reaches what the one reaches; at an occurrence that acts, these classes are closed under meets, not joins.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. At an occurrence that conditions something, a class meeting P2 (constancy up to the net's end at its class) and P4 (holding its effects) has its block closed under the net: whatever anything alike to it conditions is alike to it. Conversely, a closed block gives P4, and P2 wherever it is decided of each alike occurrence whether it conditions something. (`Becoming.«本类常闭则类闭»`, `Becoming.«类闭则本类常闭»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭当且仅当类闭»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. At an occurrence that conditions something, the meet of two classes meeting P2 and P4 meets them, and so does the meet of any family of them with a member; the family is not closed under joins: two such classes can have a least common coarsening that holds an occurrence alike to the member and not its effect. (`Becoming.«合为类»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭之交»`, `Becoming.«皆»`, `Becoming.«皆为类»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭之遍交»`, `Becoming.JoinBreaks.J_least`, `Becoming.JoinBreaks.J_fails`, `Becoming.JoinBreaks.E_meets`, `Becoming.JoinBreaks.F_meets`, `Becoming.JoinBreaks.E_le_J`, `Becoming.JoinBreaks.F_le_J`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. The class holding an occurrence alike with everything downstream of it, and nothing else with anything, is defined from the net and the occurrence alone; wherever some class meets P2 and P4 at the occurrence it does too, or wherever it is decided of each occurrence downstream whether it conditions something, or wherever everything within the occurrence's closure has the occurrence within its own, as at an element returning along the net; every class meeting them contains it. (`Becoming.«后类»`, `Becoming.«后类为类»`, `Becoming.«后类之本»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则后皆同»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则含后类»`, `Becoming.«后类本类常闭»`, `Becoming.«后类最细»`, `Becoming.«判则后类本类常闭»`, `Becoming.«及之首步»`, `Becoming.«返则后类本类常闭»`, `Becoming.ReturnsAlong.downstreamClass_regular`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Under every class meeting P2 and P4 at an occurrence, its line reaches exactly what a line under the one reaches, under the least class with no premise; given P2, P4 is equivalent to that. With each center under a class of its own meeting P2 and P4, the per-center condition along the net is the condition at the one, and along a net with no cycle it holds only where every center is one and the same occurrence. (`Becoming.«本类常闭则所及即一之所及»`, `Becoming.«后类之所及即一之所及»`, `Becoming.«本类常则闭当且仅当所及即一之所及»`, `Becoming.«各本类常闭则续无外即一之续无外»`, `Becoming.«各后类续无外即一之续无外»`, `Becoming.«各续无外则同一中心»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. The identity meets P2 at every occurrence, the least class that does, and fails P4 wherever the occurrence conditions something other than itself. P2 alone is not closed under meets, and where the occurrence conditions nothing the meet of two classes meeting P2 and P4 can fail P2. (`Becoming.«静之本类至终有常»`, `Becoming.«静最细»`, `Becoming.«静不闭»`, `Becoming.MeetBreaks.E_constant`, `Becoming.MeetBreaks.F_constant`, `Becoming.MeetBreaks.meet_not_constant`, `Becoming.MeetBreaks.meet_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.MeetBreaks.not_held`, `Becoming.MeetBreaks.idle_both`, `Becoming.MeetBreaks.idle_meet_not_constant`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own, for every carrier, relation and class: the meet law at an occurrence that conditions something; the converse of the closure form where it is decided of each alike occurrence whether it conditions something; the witnesses' nets supplied, with equality on their carriers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which class is one's own, or that acting presupposes a class holding its effects: that is 07's crux, argued and not settled.
- That an actual self's class meets the path's regularity, or holds its effects.
- That the classes meeting the regularity alone have a least member other than the moment: the identity meets it everywhere, and that family is not closed under meets. Witness: `Becoming.MeetBreaks.meet_not_constant_at`.
- That the classes meeting both are closed under joins. Witness: `Becoming.JoinBreaks.J_fails`.
- That the meet law holds where the occurrence conditions nothing. Witness: `Becoming.MeetBreaks.idle_meet_not_constant`.
- Any order of courses: holding one's effects ranks nothing.
- Which occurrences are centers.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

The crux, now the whole of the de se question on the path: whether acting presupposes a class holding one's effects, put to philosophers; and, with centers read off a flow, the per-center condition restated on them.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Read de se: where one's own class meets the path's two conditions, the net fixes the least such class, oneself with everything one's acts condition at any remove (the widest self of 07's table, least only among classes granted to hold one's effects: the net does not make them one's own), and what every such class reaches, that same downstream; which of them is one's own it does not fix, and nothing the line reaches turns on it. So, granted the regularity, the de se question on the path has nothing left but whether one's class holds one's effects; at an occurrence that conditions something other than itself, the identity, a self of one moment, meets the regularity and not that. The reading is the AI's.
